---
name: Bug report
about: Something in PicoBoy itself does not work
title: ""
labels: bug
---

**Please do not attach game files or links to download them.**

**What happened?** (and what did you expect?)
**How can it be repeated?** (steps, starting from switching the PicoSystem on)
**PicoBoy version:** (for example v1.0)
**What the screen shows:** (word for word if there is text: a red message, "SAVES OFF", an error number, ...)
**Anything unusual about your PicoSystem?** (other programs installed, an old firmware, a different cable, ...)

If you can, connect the PicoSystem by USB and copy the text that a serial terminal shows (115200 baud): the lines starting with `saves:`, `save:`, `starting` and `core error` are the useful ones.
